messages:
ryan_w: Hey team :wave: I'm a new ML infra hire (ryan_w). First day — I need access to Datadog, Grafana, and Sentry to follow onboarding guides. Who should I ping / what's the quickest path? Thanks!

linda_devex: Welcome! :sparkles: Check Okta first — apps named 'Redwood Grafana', 'Redwood Datadog', 'Redwood Sentry'. If they're not in Okta, post a request in #help with your email and the services. For Grafana viewer/editor we usually add folks to groups: `redwood-grafana-viewers` or `redwood-grafana-editors`.

sam_infra: I can add you to Datadog as a viewer. Ping me your corporate email here or DM. Datadog provisioning usually finishes within minutes.

onboarding-bot: INFO: Provisioning requests typically take 1-2 business days. For faster turnaround, tag @sam_infra or @linda_devex in your #help request.

ryan_w: I don't see those apps in Okta. My email is ryan.w@redwood.ai — thanks @sam_infra

sam_infra: Got it, added you to `redwood-datadog-viewer` and sent an invite to ryan.w@redwood.ai. You should get a "Welcome to Datadog" email shortly. :thumbsup:�

ryan_w: Datadog invite arrived, can log in — thanks! Grafana still shows "You do not have permission to view this dashboard". Which dashboard should I ask for?

linda_devex: For onboarding, request viewer access to these dashboards: "infra / default overview", "models / inference-latency", and "alerts / oncall-runbook". Paste the dashboard links when you file the ticket, e.g.:

https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd1234/infra-default-overview?orgId=1

You only need editor access if you'll be modifying panels.

nina_sre: Sentry is project-scoped. Please file a #help ticket with this template:

Subject: Add ryan_w to Sentry projects
Body:
- Email: ryan.w@redwood.ai
- Projects: inference, model-monitoring
- Role: Member (read + issue creation)

I'll triage and add you once the ticket is in. If you include the Grafana links we can also add SRE dash viewers.

ryan_w: Filed the ticket in #help and pasted the links + email. Thanks everyone!

sam_infra: Confirmed Datadog role is active for ryan_w (viewer). If anything looks off run a quick login check at https://app.datadoghq.com/ and lmk.

linda_devex: Once Sentry/Grafana are provisioned, follow the Observability onboarding checklist in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ONBOARD/Observability — ping me if you hit any missing steps.

ryan_w: All set — Grafana viewer access granted and Sentry added to inference. Closing the loop, really appreciate the quick help :heart:
